faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Short answers for tuition centre owners evaluating TLAS.MY.

items.question: Is TLAS.MY for parents and students too?
items.answer: Not yet. The MVP is for owners, admins, and teachers. Parent/student portals can come later.

items.question: Can parents pay tuition through TLAS.MY?
items.answer: For MVP, tuition payments are recorded manually. Stripe is used only for the centre's TLAS.MY subscription.

items.question: Does it support Bahasa Malaysia?
items.answer: The marketing site supports English and Bahasa Malaysia. The authenticated app is being localized progressively.

items.question: Can I import existing students?
items.answer: Yes. Admins can import students and guardians using the CSV template in the Students page.

items.question: What happens after the trial?
items.answer: Choose Starter or Pro from Billing. If a trial or subscription is inactive, new record creation is limited until billing is resolved.
